part_b_link_coverage.conclusion: all 36 locale pages + legal.html are already reachable via the shared header.html/footer.html navigation, injected identically on every page; the Phase 3 orphan finding was a static-crawl methodology limitation (already documented in Phase 3 report Section 8), not a real defect. A supplementary link block was drafted and applied, then reverted after live-browser verification proved it would duplicate existing working navigation.
part_b_link_coverage.verification_method: loaded id/index.html in a real headless browser against a local HTTP server and read the live DOM's resolved absolute href values for faq.html, packing-calculator.html, and whatsapp-catalog.html -- all correctly resolved to the /id/ locale path via the shared header fragment

regression.duplicate_canonical_target_after_verdict: all 9 are the correct stub+destination consolidation pattern, none are defects
